draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Thanks for writing in about inviting a teammate last week -- Tariq confirmed a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and that ticket is now closed. If it would help, teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

The other piece worth setting up is your first project: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week work to get Lantern Studio's first project set up together?

Best,
Priya
